entries.name: Tornellan Protector
entries.reason: Japanese image specifies a target creature dealing the next damage to a target player. Current English text and Forge target one creature or player as recipient, preventing a separately randomized 1–3 each damage event for the turn. Difference confirmed; no publisher errata or original executable behavior was verified. The old wording may be erroneous but its cause is unconfirmed.
entries.currentEnglishRules: {T}: Until end of turn, each time damage is dealt to target creature or player, prevent X of that damage, where X is a number from 1 to 3 chosen at random each time.
